riskSignals.rationale: Regular HTML, official PDF, seasonal buffet PDF, and multiple ordering vendors are present.
Official regular and seasonal PDF menus require PDF extraction and scope interpretation.
Frozen baseline contains 88 items; current regular official menu has a materially different beverage catalog and adds/removes several products.
No restaurant-issued allergen matrix or complete ingredient disclosure was located.

findings.summary: The current official menu removes many frozen beverage products and adds current products including Fries, Fiji Water Bottle, and S. Pellegrino Sparkling Water.

Official menu descriptions contain selected positive ingredients such as yogurt, milk, tahini, egg yolk, fish, wheat-containing naan, and nuts, but do not provide complete contains, may-contain, or cross-contact arrays. Missing allergens are therefore unavailable rather than negative.
Ramadan Iftar Buffet PDF is a seasonal service-period menu and is excluded from the regular current product boundary.

summary: Identity is supported by the official homepage and menu. The official regular HTML menu is the complete current regular catalog; official PDF and ordering-vendor surfaces are duplicate or partial corroboration. The frozen baseline requires substantial reconciliation: most food items remain current with normalized names, while many frozen beverage products are stale extras. Allergen disclosure is incomplete, so absent allergens and cross-contact remain unavailable; explicit positive ingredients in descriptions are retained as narrow restaurant-issued ingredient evidence.
